Package dev.opencollab.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockItemVariant

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.vanilla.BedrockItemVariant
public final class BedrockItemVariant extends Object
A variant of a BedrockItemType: the type and its aux value. Paletter says "aux" for the value that names a variant (BDS's aux value, the damage field of Cloudburst's ItemData); "damage" is only an item's wear. The block a stack places is not part of the variant, it belongs to the stack (BedrockItemStack.blockState()). Obtained from BedrockItemType.variant(int) and BedrockItemType.variants(), or BedrockItemType.base() for the base variant.

Equality: as for BedrockItemType, equals always works. == works too for the variants of the vanilla constants (the types of BedrockItems, the named variants their getters give) and for the base variant of registered custom content: customItem.type().base() is the very variant Palette.decode(org.cloudburstmc.protocol.bedrock.data.inventory.ItemData) gives back. Variants made by BedrockItemType.variant(int) for an aux value that is not one of BedrockItemType.variants(), and variants of types made for unknown identifiers, are new objects: compare those with equals.

Since:
1.0.0

    • byIdentifier

      public static @Nullable BedrockItemVariant byIdentifier(@NonNull String identifier, int aux)
      Finds the vanilla variant of an identifier and aux value, without making a type for an unknown identifier. Splits (a legacy variant that became its own type) and renames of the bundled data are applied first. Loads the data.
      Parameters:
      identifier - an item identifier
      aux - the aux value
      Returns:
      the variant of a vanilla constant, or null if the identifier (after splits and renames) is not an item of the newest bundled data and has no generated constant
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the identifier is null
      Since:
      1.0.0
